    Corollary 2.11: the translations of Γ_{A₀} and Γ_A agree #

    graded-category.tex (proof of cor:same-ar-quiver): "every right mesh map is right almost split. ... Thus the meshes are the almost split sequences and give the translation."

    Evaluated at the projective labels, the right mesh map at x is f_x : ⊕_a M_{mid a} → M_x (mesh0), with kernel M_{τ x} at a nonprojective x (tau0) and injective at a projective x.

    Deviation: instead of proving that f_x is right minimal by degrees, we compare f_x with the chosen minimal right almost split map c of the vendored library. Every component of c is radical, so c factors through f_x (c = h' f_x), and f_x is not split epi, so f_x = h c. Minimality of c makes h' h invertible, which identifies ker c with a summand of ker f_x; as ker f_x ≅ M_{τ x} is indecomposable, the two kernels agree.

                      Corollary 2.11 (cor:same-ar-quiver): Γ_{A₀} ≅ Γ_A as translation quivers. Both have the vertex set Fin n, and the identity matches the arrows, the nonprojective and noninjective vertices, and the translations.
